create_PedestalModel: create a PedestalModel instance with formation and saturation models to calculate pedestal temperature and density
build_PedestalModelOutput: build a PedestalModelOutput dataclass containing pedestal top location, ion and electron temperatures, and electron density
configure_BasePedestal: configure a BasePedestal pydantic model subclass to define pedestal runtime parameters and transport coefficients
register_pedestal_model: register a custom pedestal model pydantic class with TORAX to extend the available pedestal configurations
create_RuntimeParams: create RuntimeParams with mode, formation, saturation settings, and transport coefficient bounds for the pedestal model
